rv.q: Overall way more wins than missteps, even with way many dog puns and an attempt to cram the whole history of the dog's evolution into one skit.
Beneath the punch lines, the production finds something affectionate and familiar in the bond between dogs and people.
Ably directed by Richard Israel ( Violet, " Big Little Lies"), each monologue invites hilarity and then smoothly moves into the new one.

cn.t: Critics praise this inventive comedy that gives dogs a voice through sharp, witty monologues. Emmy and Grammy winner David Javerbaum's clever writing deftly explores what's on our canine companions' minds.
